headline: EU member states set shared priorities for safe, sovereign and sustainable AI in the Dublin Declaration
summary: Participating EU member states adopted Ireland’s Dublin Declaration on 14 October 2026. The document records shared intentions across AI safety and resilience, trusted adoption, European sovereignty, infrastructure and skills, sustainability, public-sector procurement, and international cooperation. It is a political commitment, not a binding legal instrument; this record does not establish new legal duties, funded delivery or implementation.
